title: Medical Laboratory
objective: Complete medical laboratory workflow from patient order to archiving
content: Medical Laboratory notebook template with 9 predefined workflow pages for routine clinical laboratory testing.

pages.title: Patient Order
pages.instructions: Capture patient information and test orders. Record patient demographics, requesting clinician, clinical indication, and ordered tests. Link to existing patient records where available.
pages.content: Patient Order - Test order registration and patient metadata capture

pages.title: Sample Collection
pages.instructions: Document sample collection details. Record specimen type, collection site, collection date/time, collector identity, and pre-analytical conditions. Verify adequate sample volume and appropriate container used.

pages.title: Quality Check
pages.instructions: Perform pre-analytical QC on received samples. Assess sample condition, volume adequacy, hemolysis, lipemia, and icterus. Verify labeling accuracy. Accept or reject samples with documented reason.
pages.content: Quality Check - Pre-analytical sample quality assessment

pages.title: Sample Routing
pages.instructions: Route samples to appropriate analysis sections or departments. Assign samples to analyzers, workstations, or external reference labs. Track chain of custody during routing.
pages.content: Sample Routing - Routing to appropriate analysis destination

pages.title: Sample Processing
pages.instructions: Execute pre-analytical processing steps. Centrifuge, aliquot, dilute, or otherwise prepare samples for testing. Document all processing steps and resulting aliquots.
pages.content: Sample Processing - Pre-analytical preparation and aliquoting

pages.title: Testing / Analyzer
pages.instructions: Execute analytical tests using laboratory analyzers or manual methods. Load samples onto analyzer, run controls, and verify calibration status. Document instrument ID, reagent lot numbers, and run parameters.

pages.title: Result Entry
pages.instructions: Enter and review test results. Record numeric or qualitative results with appropriate units and reference ranges. Flag abnormal results for review. Document any repeat testing or confirmatory tests performed.
pages.content: Result Entry - Test result recording and flagging

pages.title: Validation & Reporting
pages.instructions: Perform technical and clinical validation of results. Apply delta check and critical value rules. Authorize and release validated results. Generate patient reports and transmit to requesting clinicians.
pages.content: Validation & Reporting - Result validation, authorization, and reporting

pages.title: Archiving
pages.instructions: Archive completed samples and finalize documentation. Store residual samples according to retention policy. Archive test records and maintain audit trail for compliance and traceability.
